lines.say: My Careem is here, but I only have two hundred rupees!
lines.cap: My Careem is here, but I only have 200 rupees!

lines.say: Two checks! Is the ride here? Then, enough cash? That's a nested if!
lines.cap: Two checks! Is the ride here? Then, enough cash? That's a nested if!

lines.say: An if inside an if! The inner one runs only if the outer is true.
lines.cap: An if inside an if! The inner one runs only if the outer is True.

lines.say: Why eight spaces on that print?
Each if adds four more! Eight spaces means it lives inside both!
lines.cap: Each if adds 4 more! 8 spaces means it lives inside BOTH!

lines.say: Your turn! Pause, and predict! What prints?
lines.cap: Your turn! Pause and predict! What prints?

lines.say: Samosa! The outer check is true, the inner one is false!
lines.cap: Samosa! The outer check is True, the inner one is False!

lines.say: Yes! The outer if lets us in, then the inner else runs!
lines.cap: Yes! The outer if lets us in, then the inner else runs!
